description: We at Arclight, a brilliant group of students is dedicated to create project for the purpose of aiding humanity in it's travel across the stars by providing the best solutions for any challenge.
summary:
Nova A.I is an A.I powered fire safety system designed to improve fire safety in microgravity environments, especially aboard spacecraft, planetary outposts, and space stations. Using data collected by NASA researchers, and physics simulations with over 300 different parameters, Nova AI aims to find the best solutions for fire safety in space and predict flame behaviour in any environment varying from low gravity to high gravity.

Nova A.I analyses your prompt and scrolls through its data library collected from NASA, to find the best way to prevent the spread of fires and to ensure the control of fire behaviour in low gravity conditions. Nova A.I also has the capability to aid in experimental research using its local physics model; to help visualise, and interpret fire behaviour in any condition.

Our goal with Nova is to make space missions safer by reducing fire related risks, and to be used in future missions for the benefit of humanity.
details: Nova AI is a local AI model that would be used for fire prevention and to visualize experiments related to fire. It works by analysing your prompt and referring to its data library to find the best way to prevent the dangers of fire in low gravity conditions. It also has the capability to simulate fires in specified conditions using physics and over 300 parameters. It is intended to be used by astronauts for space missions related to fire safety and fire experimentation. The expected impact would be to ensure the dangers of fire can be avoided in space and to help with experimental results. We used Visual Studio along with the coding languages: C# for calculations and backend followed by XML for the user interface. Our project is creative by making full use of local AI, and interactive user interfaces. The factors our team considered is the weight of the model, this is because since our project is meant to go to space it should not interfere much with the payload of spacecraft since to reach escape velocity, an optimized weight is preferred. With that our model was made to be very light but effective, being able to properly run find solutions for fire prevention and run physic simulations even on small servers without much problem.
